question.text: When two tuning forks (fork 1 and fork 2) are sounded simultaneously, 4 beats per second are heard. Now, some tape is attached on the prong of the fork 2 . When the tuning forks are sounded again, 6 beats per seconds are heard. If the frequency of fork 1 is $200 \mathrm{~Hz}$, then what was the original frequency of fork 2 ?

solution.text:
$$
\left|f_1-f_2\right|=4
$$
Since mass of second tuning fork increases so $f_2$ decrease and beats increase so
$$
\begin{aligned}
& f_1>f_2 \\
& \Rightarrow f_2=f_1-4=196
\end{aligned}
$$
